rationale: Exact Document Intelligence owner adoption has not occurred: no admitted public DI contract is wired into this repository. Retiring the Kernel adapter now would prematurely break the legacy ProductRuntimeFacets.OcrProvider consumer shape; replacing it with a Media-owned executor would be an unqualified OCR claim.

retirementPreconditions.diOwnerAdoption: An admitted Document Intelligence public client is wired and proven — external owner: Ghatana #252
retirementPreconditions.consumerMigration: Every registered consumer of ProductRuntimeFacets.OcrProvider has a verified migration path to the DI-owned capability
retirementPreconditions.proofArtifacts: Migration/consumer proof recorded before adapter source is removed

currentState.claim: No OCR capability is claimed. extract()/status()/cancel() return bounded terminal failures only; the legacy constructor shape and provider interface are preserved for consumer compatibility.
currentState.closure: Closure is limited to fail-closed compatibility; no retirement commit may land without the preconditions above.
